For live concurrency, mirror _saved_concurrency's explicit None handling, integer conversion error handling, and rejection below one. Hoist the comparison predicate verbatim to one module-level helper with no filtering change. For execution_order, document one persisted-column policy and pin it across multiple throughput streams and the standard path; retain current behavior if the decision supports it, or change only the order mapping if unification is required. description: Three bounded follow-ups remain on current develop after PR #1644. First, benchbox/cli/run_resolution.py builds the live RunRequest with concurrency=int(getattr(state, "concurrency", None) or 1), so explicit concurrency=0 is silently promoted to 1; the same file's _saved_concurrency already uses the required explicit-None, int-conversion, and less-than-one validation. Second, benchbox/core/analysis/comparison.py defines the identical is_comparable closure three times; one module-level helper can preserve behavior verbatim. Third, throughput capture maps each stream-local position into QueryExecution.execution_order, so different streams can persist overlapping values, while standard capture keeps an explicit global execution_order or supplies a flattened 1-based index and ignores producer position. Existing comments and path-local tests deliberately pin those conversions independently, but they do not record whether the persisted INTEGER NOT NULL execution_order column may mix stream-local and global semantics or pin the cross-stream persistence contract. This third point is a latent semantic inconsistency, not a crash or wrong-result defect; its required outcome is a recorded decision and a persistence-focused test, with a behavior change only if that decision requires one.

anti_patterns.dont: Assume the existing path-local comments and tests settle the persisted-column contract.
anti_patterns.instead: Add a persistence-focused or equivalent cross-path contract test that makes the chosen semantics falsifiable.
anti_patterns.why: They verify each conversion independently but do not test overlapping stream positions against the flattened standard ordering contract.

anti_patterns.dont: Change status filtering or duration selection while hoisting is_comparable.
anti_patterns.instead: Move the predicate verbatim to one module-level helper and redirect the three call sites.
anti_patterns.why: The three closures are identical and this refactor has a zero-behavior-change contract.

anti_patterns.dont: Describe the execution_order inconsistency as a crash or wrong-result defect.
anti_patterns.instead: Record the semantic decision and pin cross-stream plus standard persistence behavior.
anti_patterns.why: Both paths currently satisfy the NOT NULL schema; the problem is mixed persisted semantics.

anti_patterns.dont: Replace one falsy coalescing expression with another truthiness-based default.
anti_patterns.instead: Mirror _saved_concurrency: default only None, convert with explicit error handling, and reject values below one.
anti_patterns.why: Zero is invalid input that must be rejected, not treated as an absent value.

anti_patterns.dont: Touch or regress the precise throughput-duration expression adjacent to execution_order mapping.
anti_patterns.instead: Limit result_capture changes to execution_order documentation or mapping and its focused tests.
anti_patterns.why: The completed stop-manufactured-zero-durations item owns producer fidelity, and missing/sub-millisecond duration behavior is now pinned.

preserves.behavior: An omitted or None live CLI concurrency still resolves to the single-stream default of 1.
Comparison filtering and schema/export duration rounding remain unchanged.
Comparison includes SUCCESS and UNKNOWN executions and excludes explicitly failed or skipped executions exactly as before.
The is_comparable hoist changes no query-id, timing, averaging, or status-filter behavior.
The persisted queries.execution_order column remains INTEGER NOT NULL; any local-versus-global semantic choice is explicit and tested rather than accidental.
Throughput capture continues to preserve missing duration as None, explicit zero as 0.0 ms, and sub-millisecond precision.
Valid positive concurrency values retain their exact value, and live and saved quick-restart paths reject the same invalid field shapes.
